test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the option that has only biodegradable substances.

options.text: Eggshells, Paper, Stale biscuits, Fruits, Vegetable peels
Batteries, Vegetable peelings, Stale bread, Glass, Metals
Tetra packs, Metals, Leather, Stale biscuits, Fruits
Glass, Metals, Egg shells, Paper, Tetra packs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Eggshells, Paper, Stale biscuits, Fruits, Vegetable peels.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biodegradable substances are those that can be decomposed by natural processes, such as microorganisms and bacteria, into harmless substances that do not harm the environment.**
 
• The option that has only biodegradable substances includes **eggshells, paper, stale biscuits, fruits, and vegetable peels.**
 
• Eggshells are biodegradable and can be used as fertilizer for plants.
 
• Paper is made from wood pulp, which is a natural material, and can be recycled or composted.
 
• **Stale biscuits, fruits, and vegetable peels are organic waste that can be composted and used as natural fertilizer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Since non-biodegradable materials do not readily react with or disintegrate in soil, they are not easily influenced by natural processes. **
 
• Batteries and metals are non-biodegradable substances that can harm the environment if not disposed of properly.
 
• Glass can be recycled but takes a long time to decompose.
 
• Stale bread and vegetable peelings can be composted.
 
• Tetra packs are made of multiple layers of materials, including plastic and aluminum, and take a long time to decompose.
 
• **Leather is a natural material but takes a long time to decompose. **
